summary: Implemented Graph.cbd in rdflib/graph.py (last method of Graph, before ConjunctiveGraph) with a nested add_to_cbd helper covering the three CBD rules: rules 1-2 with exact BNode type check and cycle guard, and rule 3 reification with no rdf:Statement or predicate/object matching. Added test/test_graph_cbd.py with CbdTestCase using my own Turtle fixture and hand-counted expectations. Nothing was run (no tests, flake8, or installs) and nothing was committed.
